name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Terms for a provider selling cloud software or SaaS to a customer, covering access, fees, data, warranties and liability.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.ask: What cloud service or product is the customer subscribing to?
fields.complete: The name of the cloud service or product, and what it is if the name does not say.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.ask: When does the order start?
fields.complete: A specific calendar day; a day that can be worked out from today, like a named weekday, also counts.
vague: a month or season with no day
soon, or when the parties sign

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.ask: How long is each subscription period (1 year is common)?
fields.complete: A specific length of time for each subscription period, with its unit.
vague: as long as needed, or ongoing, with no length

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.ask: The subscription renews automatically unless a party gives notice: how many days before the end of a period must that notice come?
fields.complete: A number of days before the end of the period.
fields.default: 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period

fields.label: Fees
fields.ask: What are the fees, and how often are they charged?
fields.complete: An amount with its currency and how it is charged: per month, per year, per unit or as a one-time fee.
vague: an amount with no charging period and no one-time wording
reasonable fees, or to be agreed

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.ask: How will the customer pay: by invoice, with how many days to pay, or by automatic payment (invoicing annually in advance, due in 30 days, is common)?
fields.complete: The method (invoice or automatic payment), how often and, for invoices, the number of days to pay.
vague: by invoice, with no days to pay

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.ask: What technical support will the provider give?
fields.complete: The kind of support and when it is available.
fields.default: email support during the provider's business hours

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.ask: When should the agreement take effect?
fields.complete: A specific calendar day; a day that can be worked out from today, like a named weekday, also counts.
vague: a month or season with no day
soon, or when the parties sign

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.ask: Which state's or country's law should govern the agreement?
fields.complete: The full official name of one state or country.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.ask: Which courts should handle disputes (usually the state or federal courts in one city in the governing law's state)?
fields.complete: The courts of one named city, with its state or country.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.ask: What is the general limit on each party's liability?
fields.complete: A fixed amount with its currency, or a multiple of the fees over a stated period.
vague: a number with no currency or fees to multiply
fields.default: 1 times the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.ask: Which third-party claims will the provider defend the customer against?
fields.complete: The specific kinds of third-party claim that are covered, or "None".
vague: standard claims, or the usual ones
all claims, with no kinds named
fields.default: any claim that the Cloud Service infringes or misappropriates a third party's intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.ask: Which third-party claims will the customer defend the provider against?
fields.complete: The specific kinds of third-party claim that are covered, or "None".
vague: standard claims, or the usual ones
all claims, with no kinds named
fields.default: any claim that Customer Content, or the customer's use of the Cloud Service in breach of the Agreement, infringes a third party's rights or violates the law

fields.label: DPA
fields.ask: Is there a Data Processing Agreement between the parties? If so, which one?
fields.complete: The name and date of the Data Processing Agreement, or "None".

fields.label: Changes to the Standard Terms
fields.ask: Would you like any changes to the standard terms (most people have none)?
fields.complete: The specific terms to change and how they should read, or "None".
vague: change the liability section, with no new wording

name: Service Level Agreement

fields.complete: A specific calendar day; a day that can be worked out from today, like a named weekday, also counts.
vague: a month or season with no day
soon, or when the parties sign

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.ask: How soon must the provider report a breach of protected health information?
fields.complete: A specific length of time, with its unit and when it starts.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.ask: Should the provider be restricted from subcontracting, offshoring, de-identifying or aggregating the data?
fields.complete: The specific restrictions, or "None".

fields.label: Changes to the Standard Terms
fields.ask: Would you like any changes to the standard terms (most people have none)?
fields.complete: The specific terms to change and how they should read, or "None".
vague: change the liability section, with no new wording

name: AI Addendum
description: Terms for AI features in a product, covering inputs, outputs and model training. Used alongside a Cloud Service Agreement or Software License Agreement.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.ask: Which main agreement does this AI Addendum attach to (its name, the parties and its date)?
fields.complete: The main agreement's name, its parties and its date.
vague: a name with no parties or date

fields.label: Training Data
fields.ask: May the provider train AI models on the customer's inputs or outputs, and if so on which data (most customers say no)?
fields.complete: Either no training, or the specific data that may be used.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.ask: (Only if there is training data.) For what purposes may it be used?
fields.complete: The specific purposes, or "Not applicable" if there is no training data.

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.ask: Are there restrictions on how training is done (e.g. de-identifying the data first)?
fields.complete: The specific restrictions, or "None".

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.ask: Are there limits on using the customer's data to improve the product in other ways?
fields.complete: The specific limits, or "None".

fields.label: Changes to the Standard Terms
fields.ask: Would you like any changes to the standard terms (most people have none)?
fields.complete: The specific terms to change and how they should read, or "None".
vague: change the liability section, with no new wording
